title: The power of SaaS (Web Summit LIS26 session page)
what_it_says: Web Summit's session page: 'The power of SaaS', November 11, 2026, 11:00 to 12:00 (Lisbon time), Stage 12, track Startup Showcase. Description: Over the course of an hour, explore how innovative software-as-a-service startups are streamlining operations, boosting productivity, integrating AI, and providing users with invaluable software services.
